Section III. Objectives and results chain

Objectives: Engage funding agencies in policy dialogue in order to harmonize principles, policies, standards and
practices related to research and capacity building in LMICs. Based on articulated TDR rules and the scope of Global
Engagement with key global health and global health research issues to inform TDR's portfolio.
ER outcome: Funding principles, policies, standards and guidance documents are agreed and implemented by
partners. TDR is partnering engaging with key GHIs and is seen as a key player in global health agenda.

Output 1: 2 tools and reports have been used to inform policy and/or practice of global/regional stakeholders or
major funding agencies
Indicator: Two harmonized principles, policies, practices introduced and adapted by funding
agencies and LMIC researchers/research institutions
Target date: 31- Dec-2019
